p.i: sufficienter. Et cum syrupo acetoso, aut oxy-melite ægrotanti si frigida sit natura ministrato.

Aliud, Coquito pulla cu eisdem herbis, foliis raphani, hordeo & aceto, fac potionem et tenuem sorbitionem. Præterea infundatur in libra vna aceti acerrimi, ficuu siccarum lib. vnius tertia, sinito per diem et noctem, postmodum coletur. Huius aceti vncias tres accipito, aquæ decoctionis radicis apij, lenticulae aquæ, vncias quatuor, zucari quantum sufficit, coquito & fac syrupum acetosum ijs conuenientem. Cumque hæc febris ab vno simplici accidit humore, vt a pituita valde crassa, quæ putrescens exteriora non valet calfacere, aut suæ crassitiei aut leuis putredinis occasione, ad febres phlegmaticas aut melancholicas aut cholericas pro victu eliciendo recurrendum est. A singulis enim prædictorum humorum originem posse habere, doctissimis viris placitum est. Unde bene dixit Arabs, „ Tu vero, inquit, non debes ad paroxysmos respicere. „ nam potest esse quod sit quotidiana,

page.notes: The two left-margin marks „ are printed quotation-continuation marks beside the lines "Tu vero" and "spicere". The page number "866" is printed in old-style figures and is read as 866 with a doubtful eighth digit. The word "tertiana," at the lower right is the catchword and is not repeated in the text.
